comment: The Tonic coarse knob's readout disagrees with the code: Wyrd.hpp:108 configures the display as 500 times 20 to the power of the knob, so it reads 500Hz at the left end, while wyrd-dsp.h:864 maps the same knob from 20Hz to 10kHz. The pitch the module plays is the code's. The Begin and End input is described by the maker as normalled high with a low gate stopping agitation; patching it also changes the gesture from a repeating cycle to a single rise that holds (wyrd-dsp.h:422-445), which the description does not say. The filter CV works out at almost exactly one octave per volt, as a tenth of the travel over an 18Hz to 18.5kHz logarithmic range is a factor of 2.005, but it is not declared as tracking and is left coloured cv.
